answer: The shale counter is kept in jetty and oasis shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2818 identities would post 2523 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
